summary: On paper Baltimore has the edge (Baltimore ranks 16th in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.10). The model favors Baltimore at 67%, mostly on rushing matchup (4.1 pts) and defensive injuries (1.3 pts).

BAL.detail: Baltimore ranks 16th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.10). Dallas' defense ranks 26th (+0.11 allowed).

DAL.detail: Dallas' defense ranks 26th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.11 allowed). Baltimore ranks 16th (+0.10).

team_cards.t1: Dallas has the NFL's worst defense vs motion.
team_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · FTN CHARTING VIA NFLVERSE
team_cards.note: Garbage time removed · BAL: n=27 dropbacks

model.summary: Model: Baltimore 67% to win, fair line BAL -5. Market: Baltimore 60%. The largest factor is rushing matchup, worth 4.1 points toward Baltimore.

model_cards.t1: The model likes Baltimore more than the market.
model_cards.sub: Win probability. Market = vig-free moneyline at build time.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Not betting advice · market line at build time

model_cards.sub: Each factor's push on the projected margin, in points. Positive = toward Dallas. Sum = BAL -5.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Linear model, so contributions are exact SHAP values · vs. an average matchup

model_cards.sub: Distribution of Dallas's margin. Shaded area = Dallas win (33%).
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Normal margin, sigma = 12.0 points (fit by log loss)

model_cards.t1: Dallas is missing 1.8 starters' worth of snaps.
model_cards.t2: Injuries move the line 0.7 points toward Baltimore.
model_cards.sub: Players listed Out, Doubtful or Questionable, weighted by recent snap share. QBs are in the QB factor.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Weight = snap share (last 4 games) x status (Out 1.0, Doubtful 0.85, Questionable 0.25)

model_cards.t1: The biggest unit gap: Baltimore's pass defense.
model_cards.t2: 0.04 EPA per play better than Dallas'.
model_cards.sub: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play vs. league average, the inputs to the model. Right = better.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Recency-weighted, last season's plays at 35% weight

model_cards.t2: It trails the market: Brier 0.226 vs. 0.211.
model_cards.sub: Walk-forward backtest, 2018-2025 (2087 games). Each season uses only earlier data.
model_cards.source: NFLVERSE PLAY-BY-PLAY · INJURIES · SNAP COUNTS · SCHEDULES (LINES)
model_cards.note: Brier score: lower is better · market = closing line

recap.text: Ravens 34, Cowboys 31. The model had the Ravens at 67% (hit). Ravens won 1 of 1 keys · Cowboys won 0 of 1 keys.
